_note: aniq_baseline_independent_convnext_base: the independent baseline (two separate CNNs, crop 55 / disease 175, pair score log P(crop) + log P(disease)) with an ImageNet-22k ConvNeXt-Base instead of ResNet-50, following Hein's recipe in independent_cnn_baseline/ (convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k, bicubic, crop scale 0.5-1, lr 5e-5 / 5e-4, 3 warmup epochs, cosine to 1% over a 30-epoch horizon, effective batch 32, gradient clip 1.0, drop path 0.1, head dropout 0.2). Hein's run reached test HM 71.44% (seen 67.00%, unseen 76.52%; epoch 15 and gamma 6.2 from one validation split). This config runs it through train/train_cnn.py with the same 3 validation splits, gamma grid and reporting as the other baselines, so it is directly comparable with them and can serve as the backbone for proposed CNN methods. Keep aniq_baseline_independent_cnn (ResNet-50) unchanged as the required baseline; this is the stronger-backbone variant.

data._note: Same splits and 333-pair protocol as the CLIP versions (generalised zero-shot).

model._note: timm ConvNeXt-Base pretrained on ImageNet-22k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (weights downloaded by timm from Hugging Face on first use). LayerNorm rather than BatchNorm, so small physical batches with gradient accumulation are equivalent to batch 32. Stochastic depth 0.1, head dropout 0.2 (Hein's recipe).

input._note: As the ResNet-50 baseline (256 px resize cache, train random resized crop 224, test resize 256 + centre crop 224, ImageNet mean/std) but bicubic resampling, which ConvNeXt was pretrained with.

augmentation._note: Hein's recipe: random resized crop scale 0.5-1 (milder than the ResNet baseline's 0.25-1), flips, brightness/contrast/saturation jitter 0.2, no hue jitter (colour is diagnostic).

loss._note: Cross-entropy with label smoothing 0.1 (long-tailed, noisy labels: median 7 images per pair). For the multi-task model the two head losses are summed with equal weight.

optimizer._note: AdamW; backbone 5e-5 (half the ResNet baseline: a larger pretrained model), heads 5e-4, weight decay 0.05.

validation._note: Same validation procedure, splits and gamma grid (log-probability units) as aniq_baseline_independent_cnn; 3 splits (Hein's study used one), so epoch and gamma are chosen the same way as for every other baseline.

training._note: Physical batch 16 x 2 accumulation steps = effective 32 (16 peaks at 3.2 GiB on the 6 GB GPU, 77 img/s). 3 linear warmup epochs, then cosine to 1% of the base rate over a fixed 30-epoch horizon (lr_schedule_epochs), so the stage-2 refit for the selected e epochs follows exactly the learning rates of the first e validation epochs. max_epochs 20 bounds stage 1 (Hein selected epoch 15 of 30). Gradient clipping at norm 1.0. About 90 s per epoch, roughly 4 h for the whole run.

evaluation._note: Pair score = log P(crop) + log P(disease). gamma (subtracted from seen pairs) from validation, in log-probability units.

runtime._note: 4 dataloader workers; images come from the resized cache.
